title: should show chip after adding a step, display the suggestion in popover, and hide chip after resolving with assertion
verifies: full happy-path lifecycle: chip hidden → visible (count 1) → popover opens with suggestion content → action adds assertion → popover closes → chip disappears

title: should auto-close popover and hide chip when suggestion count drops to zero
verifies: watcher auto-closes popover and hides chip when count transitions to 0 after clicking the add-assertion action

title: should show tooltip with correct count on hover when popover is closed, and suppress tooltip when popover is open
verifies: tooltip shows count text on hover when popover is closed; tooltip does NOT appear on hover when popover is open (OTooltip disabled)

title: should hide chip when journey has no steps, show when step added, and hide again when resolved
verifies: chip lifecycle: absent on empty journey, appears when non-assert step exists, disappears when assertion resolves the suggestion

title: should re-appear when the only assertion step is deleted
verifies: chip transitions from hidden back to visible when the only assertion step is removed from the journey

title: should stay hidden when all remaining steps are assertions after deleting the only non-assert step
verifies: chip stays hidden when only assertion steps exist (zero-assertion producer does not fire)

title: should always show non-blocking footer message inside the popover panel
verifies: non-blocking footer message ('Suggestions never block saving or running the journey.') is always visible when popover is open

title: should NOT re-open popover automatically after auto-close when suggestion re-appears — user must click chip
verifies: popover stays closed after auto-close even when a new suggestion re-appears; manual click on the chip re-opens it

title: no-test-attribute suggestion — not wired: requires recorded steps (recording-only producer)
verifies: [fixme] no-test-attribute card would appear if steps had populated locator candidates, but addStep() creates empty candidates — requires Chrome extension recording

title: separator between multiple suggestions visible — not wired: requires no-test-attribute (recording-only)
verifies: [fixme] OSeparator renders between suggestion cards when multiple suggestions are active; requires no-test-attribute producer to fire alongside zero-assertion
